stories.subject: Lil Wayne and Drake
stories.headline: WAYNE + DRAKE HAVE THE VAULT
stories.deck: Lil Wayne says he and Drake have a “whole bunch” of unreleased collaborations, including music from 2014 and 2015. He keeps updating the files and sending new versions to Drake, but no release has been announced.

stories.subject: Sean “Diddy” Combs
stories.headline: DIDDY’S DATE MOVES
stories.deck: Federal Bureau of Prisons records now list Sean Combs’ projected release date as March 2, 2028, six weeks after the prior Jan. 21 date. The Bureau has not publicly explained the change, and Combs’ spokesperson said the calculation is not disclosed.

stories.subject: Quavo and Offset / Takeoff estate
stories.headline: QUAVO + OFFSET MAY TESTIFY
stories.deck: Quavo and Offset are listed as potential witnesses in the dispute over a confidential wrongful-death settlement tied to Takeoff. Takeoff’s mother is arguing for Georgia venue against Kenneth Ball; the filings do not mean either rapper has been ordered to testify.

stories.subject: MC Lyte
stories.headline: MC LYTE HITS THE ROAD
stories.deck: MC Lyte launches her 12-city Road to the Hall of Fame tour Oct. 11 in Brooklyn. The shows combine roughly 90 minutes of performance, storytelling and career history as she celebrates her Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction.

stories.subject: Jason and Lucia / Grand Theft Auto VI
stories.headline: GTA VI GETS A HOME
stories.deck: Rockstar’s full Rob Nelson interview details safehouses that play more like interactive camps, daily routines and texting between Jason and Lucia, plus vehicles that store outfits and weapons. The Oct. 7 transcript describes a July preview build ahead of the Nov. 19 launch.

source_policy: At least two current reputable sources per story; five distinct stories; no stale or repeated topics from prior batches.
